ns2:course.label: Supp WW Inst: Clar non-WW Maj
ns2:course.description: Class instruction in the fundamentals of playing and teaching the clarinet. Acquire knowledge on recommended instruments and equipment, maintenance procedures, and training materials. Prerequisite: Intended for non-woodwind majors in the BME instrumental concentration.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Intended for non-woodwind majors in the BME instrumental concentration.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to BME:Music Education -UIUC, BME:MusEd:Instrmntl Music-UIUC, or BME:Mus Ed:Elem Gen Music-UIUC.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
